import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    n = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    m = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    s = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1

    adj = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
    for _ in range(m):
        u = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        v = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        adj[u].append(v)

    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    q = deque()
    q.append(s)
    visited[s] = True
    reachable = 0

        u = q.popleft()
        reachable += 1
